notes.title: My Little Miniatures official release!!
notes.notes:
My Little Miniatures is out now! This is an auto battler game，where you can assemble your team of little miniatures，challenging varies of unknown enemies!

[previewyoutube=1C3LzbfLzbA;full][/previewyoutube]

About this game
My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in an battle, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds!

The world of miniatures
In a piece of space of unknown, little miniatures were summoned into and divided into two side. With all different abilities and skills, they are now ready to team up and head into the epic battle!

We are trilled to say that My Little Miniatures is now officially release! Since the game is still being polished, we would like to hear any kind of comments, suggestions, or criticism, if you have any please let us know, thank you!!
